total_length_bp.verdict: REPLICATED — paper body text and NCBI both give 2,453,694 bp; the abstract's 2,476,083 bp appears to be an error/typo

gc_content_pct.verdict: REPLICATED — 66.95% vs paper's 66.9% is within rounding

num_contigs.verdict: PARTIAL — paper says 8, both NCBI records now show 2. NCBI/RefSeq likely merged/trimmed or the paper counted intermediate scaffolds

n50_bp.verdict: PARTIAL — differs because contig count differs; paper's N50 is consistent with 8 contigs, current NCBI N50 (1425513) reflects the 2-contig assembly

genes_total.verdict: REPLICATED (within re-annotation drift) — paper's number was 2022 PGAP; current is 2026 PGAP v6.11; 25-gene difference is normal for re-annotation

trnas.verdict: REPLICATED — 1 fewer tRNA in current annotation

closest_relative_our_pairwise.verdict: REPLICATED — 98.38% (pairwise) vs paper's 98.24%; differences within alignment-method variability

phylogenetic_neighbors_16S.consistency: REPLICATED — top-3 closest species agree in identity and rank order (O. umbonata > O. profusa > O. uli)

ANI.verdict: PARTIAL / SEMI-CONTRADICTED — direction consistent (all << 95% species threshold, confirms novelty) but magnitude differs; the paper likely used EzBioCloud OrthoANIu which reports lower values than fastANI/skani/ANIb for cross-genus comparisons. This is a known tool-family effect at low identity.

AAI.verdict: NOT_TESTED — AAI requires protein-vs-protein all-vs-all BLAST which is heavier; deferred

dDDH.verdict: NOT_TESTED — GGDC-v3 web-only; result would go via TYGS/GGDC job queue (not blocking novelty conclusion)

genomic_distances_vs_O_umbonata.species_delineation_conclusion: REPLICATED — every metric we DID compute (fastANI 80.8%, skani 79.4%, ANIb 83.4%) is FAR below the 95–96% ANI species boundary. Paper's core taxonomic claim (BGYT1 is a distinct Olsenella species) is independently confirmed.

physiology_claims.gram_stain: paper: negative (but ATYPICAL — Actinobacteria including Olsenella are canonically Gram-positive; body text also calls Olsenella cells 'Gram stain positive'). NOT INDEPENDENTLY TESTED — requires the live isolate.
physiology_claims.temperature_range_C: paper: 35–40 (opt 35). NOT INDEPENDENTLY TESTED — requires wet lab.
physiology_claims.verdict: OUT_OF_REACH — phenotypic claims require the live isolate KCTC 25379T / GDMCC 1.3011T

cell_wall_degrading_enzymes.spot_check_via_refseq_products: SPOT-CHECK — deferred; requires grepping current PGAP protein annotations for 'chitinase', 'glucanase', 'protease' families
